file_naming: kebab-case for all source files (e.g. repo-health.ts, code-owner-demand.ts, pr-velocity.ts)
variable_naming: camelCase for variables, functions, and parameters (e.g. repoFullName, daysSinceLastPush, fetchPullRequests)
class_naming: PascalCase for classes and interfaces, no I-prefix convention (e.g. KnexStorageProvider, StorageProvider, Config, RepoHealthStats)
constant_naming: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE for module-level constants (e.g. MAX_RETRIES, CODEOWNERS_PATHS)
test_file_naming: No test files present in codebase; project appears to be early-stage without test coverage
async_style: async/await throughout; AsyncGenerator pattern used for paginated API calls (e.g. async function* fetchOrgRepos), Promises used at library boundaries
error_handling: try/catch blocks with early returns; functions throw errors to callers (e.g. fetchCodeOwnersFile catches 404 and continues, re-throws other errors). No custom error class; relies on native Error handling and status codes.
import_style: ES modules with explicit .js extensions (e.g. import { ... } from './types.js'); path alias @ not used; absolute package imports via @kfang scoped namespace (e.g. @kfang/ghstat-github-data)
architecture: Monorepo with Nx task orchestration. Layered by package: github-data (API client) → stats (pure calculation functions) → persistence (storage abstraction) → server/backstage plugins (consumers). Each package is independently typed and exports a clean public API via index.ts.
state_management: Not applicable; project is backend-heavy data processing with no client-side state management. Storage is abstracted via StorageProvider interface.
code_generation: No generated files detected. Octokit types are from npm; not code-generated locally.
pr_conventions: No CONTRIBUTING.md or PR templates found; no branch naming conventions documented
database_and_migrations: Knex.js-based SQL migrations in KnexStorageProvider.buildMigrations(). Migrations are versioned and tracked in a schema_migrations table. Supports both SQLite (standalone) and Backstage database backends via adapter pattern. Run migrations automatically on first StorageProvider instantiation.
workspace_structure: Bun monorepo with Nx. packages/ contains: github-data (Octokit API client wrapper), stats (calculation functions), persistence (storage layer + sync orchestration), server (standalone Fastify/Alpine.js server), backstage-backend (Backstage plugin), backstage-frontend (Backstage React plugin).
dependency_injection: Manual wiring via factory functions (e.g. createSqliteProvider, createGitHubClient, createBackstageProvider). No IoC container. Consumers pass dependencies into route handlers and main index.ts.
backend_framework: Fastify for standalone server; Express-compatible request/response for Backstage backend plugin. Routes registered via registerRepoRoutes, registerPullRoutes, registerStatRoutes pattern.
configuration: YAML-based config (config.yaml) with environment variable expansion via ${VAR_NAME}. Config interface defines github (token, orgs, repos, lookback_days), persistence (type, sqlite path), refresh (interval, on_start), server (port, host). Loaded via loadConfig(configPath).
sync_orchestration: syncAll(client, storage, config, logger) handles full data sync: fetches org repos, individually listed repos, PRs, reviews, comments, timeline events, CODEOWNERS, and team members. Deduplicates repos across org and individual listings. Uses incremental sync if last_sync_time exists; falls back to lookback_days for full sync.
types_and_interfaces: Strongly typed; normalized GitHub types (GhRepo, GhPullRequest, GhPRReview, etc.) differ slightly from Octokit output to simplify consumption. StorageProvider is the storage abstraction interface. Stat calculation functions return strongly-typed result objects (RepoHealthStats, PRVelocityStats, etc.).
pagination_and_generators: GitHub API pagination via Octokit client.paginate.iterator with AsyncGenerator (yield in for-await loops). Large datasets streamed rather than buffered.
gotchas: No npm scripts to run the app directly—use bun run. Example: CONFIG_PATH=./config.yaml bun run packages/server/src/index.ts
Database path defaults to ./data/gh-stat.db; directory is auto-created. For Docker or alternative persistence, set config.persistence.type to 'backstage' and wire Backstage DatabaseService.
GitHub API CODEOWNERS fetching tries three standard paths (.github/CODEOWNERS, CODEOWNERS, docs/CODEOWNERS); if none exist, returns null (not an error).
Sync state is per-repo-full-name; incremental syncs rely on last_sync_time table. Manual sync via POST /api/sync does not respect syncRunning flag strictly—logs a warning but user must retry.
Stats calculation functions are pure; they do not fetch data themselves. Server and Backstage plugins orchestrate storage queries and pass data to calc* functions.
Backstage mode uses a table prefix (ghstat_) to avoid collisions in shared databases. Standalone mode uses no prefix.
bus factor calculation: contributors with >=10% of merged PRs, not total contributions.
additional_notes: Project is in early development (v0.1.0); no tests, no CI pipeline.
Frontend code (Alpine.js views) is served from src/views/; views are copied to dist during build.
TypeScript strict mode enabled (strict: true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noImplicitOverride). ES2022 target.
Bun package manager used; bun.lock file present. Nx for task orchestration (nx run-many -t build, typecheck, clean).
Each package declares explicit dependencies via @kfang scoped namespace (workspace: * protocol).
No linter or formatter config (.eslintrc, .prettierrc) found; assume community defaults or style enforced via code review.
